insight: Went viral on X in 2024 as a free ‘discovery engine’ from Globe Engineer, drawing comparisons to a self-assembling Wikipedia.
name: Globe Explorer
tagline: A discovery engine — a Wikipedia page for anything.
description: Globe Explorer is an AI discovery engine that turns any query into a single structured, visual page instead of a ranked list of links. It uses LLMs to break a topic into a hierarchy — broad overview down through subtopics — that you can explore, expand and share. It's free to use and aimed at learning and research rather than precise factual lookups.
edge: Returns one explorable, hierarchical page mapping a whole topic from overview to subtopics, rather than a ranked link list or a single chat answer.

references.title: AI-powered knowledge exploration with Globe Explorer
